title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 0.1 Test 9
summary: Test 9 is an unsigned build of the portable green Mouse Without Borders fork. It increases automatically generated security keys to 12 easy-to-type characters while preserving existing saved keys and the four-character minimum for manually chosen keys.
changes: Increases newly generated security keys from 10 to 12 characters.
Keeps the same 31-character lowercase-and-number alphabet that avoids ambiguous characters and punctuation.
Provides about 59.5 bits of entropy for generated keys while keeping them practical to type once on another computer.
Leaves existing saved keys untouched and continues allowing manually chosen keys of four or more characters.
Updates the automated policy test and all relevant documentation.
testing: Click New Key several times and confirm every generated key contains exactly 12 characters drawn only from abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789.
Start with an existing prefs file and confirm its saved key is not replaced during upgrade.
Use the same generated key on both computers and confirm they connect normally.
Retest mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, firewall prompting, and sleep/wake behavior with this same Test 9 EXE on both computers.
